snippet.title: Tired of Being the Hero - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
🪓 You saved the world. Now you're just trying to live in it.

Tired of Being the Hero is a first-person dark fantasy RPG with a management twist.
Train villagers. Defend your home. Face what you left behind.

🎮 Play the demo during Steam Next Fest (Oct 12–19): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3849030/Tired_of_Being_the_Hero/
🔗 Press Kit: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JrfJE2dPvJXXQ1B0RtF8Oeugh40MkIQoKlCs1ruO9sA/edit?usp=sharing
🔗 More info: https://tiredofbeingthehero.com/

Follow for updates
